verdicts.reason: Both keep the original's line-break spaces, so the headline reads as the nonsense 'CONS TRUC TION'. Both also put the $14.99 price after the button as tiny text, which separates it from 'Buy 2 only for'. A is worse: 'Buy 2 only for' sits on top of the blue X and the brick, the ORDER NOW button is too small to read, and the right end is jammed. B separates the elements better and has a clear, readable CTA, but its price is tiny and pushed against the right edge.
